name: style-guide-creator
description: Create a complete, accessible brand style guide for an organisation from just its logo. Analyses the logo, builds a WCAG 2.2 AA colour system, typography, layout, iconography, imagery, motion, voice and tone, writing style, digital, print, signage, co-branding and legal guidance, plus a full social media kit (avatars, covers, post templates with safe zones, alt-text and caption rules). Outputs an accessible HTML guide, Markdown, PDF, design tokens (DTCG JSON, CSS, SCSS, Tailwind) and a ready-to-use asset kit, all checked by an automated accessibility quality gate.
